notes: Pre-deploy sanity pass, and it found a real hole. THE TRIAL REST GATE WAS RUNNING ON A SIXTH OF THE API. It was written inside requirePlayer on the stated assumption that requirePlayer was the single REST chokepoint. IT IS NOT: only 22 of 142 routes use it. Every /api/funds, /api/fund, /api/warehouses, /api/council and /api/patreon route resolves its token inline with tokenFrom instead, so the gate never ran on any of them and a trial account could create a Capital House, buy a council seat, lease a warehouse or link a Patreon email. Found by booting the server and POSTing /api/funds/create as a live guest: it answered insufficient_funds, not guest_blocked. The gate is now global app.use middleware mounted before any route is declared, so it sees every request regardless of how that route authenticates, and it fails open to next() on a throw rather than 500ing the entire API. GET IS NO LONGER BLOCKED. Prefix matching was also stopping a trial from BROWSING Capital Houses, the Fbay shelf and warehouse quotes, which is the opposite of showing someone the game. Audited: every GET under the blocked prefixes is a read. tools/guest-check.mjs now asserts the gate is global and refuses to pass if it moves back inside requirePlayer. Verified against a running server: 19 REST gates, 12 blocked and 7 open, plus WebSocket blocks, the chat unlock, the full upgrade round trip, every upgrade failure path with recovery, live expiry, settle and lock, and normal-account regression. SERVER RESTART REQUIRED.
